Scanners checking that the range apparatus itself behaved, built on [inspect_scout](https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_scout/). The scanner form covers both consumption paths: scan finished logs with `scout scan inspect_ranges/range_apparatus -T ./logs` (or `inspect_scout.scan` from Python), or put it directly in a task's scorer list to run online beside `challenge_scorer`, as the packaged example tasks do. See [Running the Range](../building.qmd#scan) for the development usage and what a finding looks like.
